title: 第14章  真的什么要求都可以？
slug: 我一杂役怎么成掌门孩子他爹了
content_zh:
太玄宗，内门。
叶长天去内门事务处报了到，领取了内门弟子的服饰与身份令牌，就来到自己在内门分配的住所。
这是一座占地面积足有两三百平的独立院落。
叶长天查看了一下院落的环境，对于这里的条件显然是相当满意。
太玄宗内门弟子不仅可以居住在灵气最为浓郁的主峰修行。
而且还有这样一座独立的院落作为修炼洞府。
这待遇与杂役弟子相比，简直一个天上，一个地下。
“内门弟子每个月可以领取一千灵石，新晋内门弟子还可以免费挑选一门术法神通，要不先去把福利领了？”
叶长天摩挲着下巴。
他现在虽然突破了筑基境，却没修炼过任何术法神通。
仅靠这一身修为，虐一虐炼气境的菜鸟倒是没啥问题，可若是与筑基境的修士战斗，恐怕就够呛了。
想到这里。
叶长天也没有犹豫。
他先是去领取了一千灵石的修炼资源，然后又去藏经阁挑选了一门术法神通。
在玄黄大世界。
术法神通与境界是相对应的，分为筑基术法，金丹术法，元婴神通等等。
每一境的术法又分为下品，中品，上品，极品。
品级越高，威力自然就越强大。
太玄宗新晋内门弟子，可在藏经阁免费任选一门筑基术法。
叶长天最终挑选了一门极品筑基术法。

苍炎剑诀！
叶长天之所以选择苍炎剑诀，主要是因为看到了苍炎剑诀的介绍。
这苍炎剑诀乃是一门金丹术法的简化版！
他或许能借助阴阳造化界的力量，恢复这门金丹术法的原貌！
事实也正如叶长天所料。
当他将藏经阁长老拓印的苍炎剑诀放入阴阳造化界后，苍炎剑诀就在阴阳之力的作用下发生了翻天覆地的变化。
到得最后。
一门全新的术法直接呈现在了阴阳造化界中。
叶长天连忙查看了这门术法的信息。
焚虚剑诀！
极品金丹术法！
以自身修为凝聚一道焚虚剑气斩灭一切，若是修炼到极致，可一剑将千米空间焚毁成虚无！
“嘶——”
叶长天忍不住倒吸一口凉气。
不愧是极品金丹术法。
好霸道的威力！
不过——
金丹术法威力虽然比筑基术法要强大百倍，但修起来也会困难不知多少倍。
以他的天赋，修炼个筑基术法都不容易。
想要修炼这焚虚剑诀，绝对不是一件容易的事情啊。

摇了摇头。
叶长天将意念集中在焚虚剑诀上，仔细地观摩着焚虚剑诀的内容。
可就在下一秒。
叶长天感觉自己仿佛置身于一片神秘空间，然后不断演练气焚虚剑诀。
很快地。
叶长天对于焚虚剑诀的运用越来越熟练。
在这般不知疲倦的演练下。
也不知道过了多久。
一道长达三米的焚虚剑气，瞬间将叶长天面前的空间斩出了一道虚无的裂痕。
与此同时。
叶长天也从那种玄妙的状态中清醒了过来。
最让叶长天惊骇的是。
这门焚虚剑诀竟然已经深深烙印在了他的脑海中，仿佛真的已经被他演练过千遍万遍一般！
叶长天一脸不可思议。
刚才他用意念查看焚虚剑诀的那一瞬间，莫名其妙就进入到了一种演练焚虚剑诀的状态。
等清醒过来的时候，自己就真的掌握焚虚剑诀了！
这……这究竟是什么情况？
他记得先前将苍炎剑诀恢复成焚虚剑诀的时候，阴阳造化界中的阴阳之力大概消耗了三分之二。
如今剩下那三分之一也没了。
“难道我用意念在阴阳造化界查看术法，还可以直接消耗阴阳之力演练术法，瞬间将术法掌握？”

叶长天顿时兴奋不已。
不愧是拥有夺天地造化的阴阳造化界。
太特么牛逼了！
如此一来，他就再也不用担心术法修炼困难的问题了！
“这阴阳造化界逆天归逆天，唯一的缺点就是个吞金兽，从火凤儿那搞来的一万灵石又花完了。”
叶长天苦笑一声。
“努力搞钱才是王道啊。”
叶长天暗自嘀咕了一句，正要准备离开藏经阁的时候，耳边却是突然传来一阵不可置信的惊呼声音。
“叶长天，你……你怎么会在这里？”
叶长天眼眸一抬，一道熟悉的身影就出现在了他的视线中。
前未婚妻柳嫣然。
没想到竟然在这里遇上了。
“柳嫣然，好巧啊。”
叶长天嘴角顿时掀起了一抹弧度：“刚晋升成内门弟子，我来藏经阁领取一门术法，有问题吗？”
“晋升内门弟子？就你？”
柳嫣然仿佛听到了这个世界上最好笑的笑话，脸庞上尽是讥笑的神色。
叶长天是什么货色，她比任何人都清楚。
伪灵根的废物。
在杂役峰修炼了三年，结果炼气一层都没突破。
而想要进入内门，除非一些天赋极佳的天才，一般都要达到筑基境才有那个资格！

叶长天这个废物，怎么可能有进入内门的资格？
“你爱信不信。”
叶长天撇了撇嘴，也不想跟柳嫣然浪费时间，转身就要离开。
“叶长天，你跟我过来！”
柳嫣然见状，一把抓住叶长天的手臂，将叶长天拉到了一个没人的角落。
叶长天一把甩开柳嫣然，没有好气地道：“柳嫣然，你想干什么？”
“说吧，你到底要怎样才能把留影石给我？”
柳嫣然也没有废话，冷冷地道：“只要你将留影石给我，有什么要求我都可以答应你。”
留影石，她无论如何也要从叶长天手中拿回来。
她可不想一辈子都受制于叶长天！
“真的什么要求都可以？”
叶长天目光在柳嫣然身上扫了扫，笑吟吟地看着柳嫣然，然后比划出了一个十的手势。
“十次太多了，最多一次！”
柳嫣然还以为叶长天是想要与她欢好，咬了咬牙道。
反正她与叶长天也有过很多次，而且体验也不差，只要能拿回留影石，再来一次也没什么大不了的。
“……”
叶长天人都麻了。
这女人特么的什么脑回路啊。
他看起来像是那么饥渴的人吗？
老子要的是灵石！

要你那十次八次有毛用？
“什么十次一次的，你想得倒是挺美的。”
叶长天满头黑线地道：“我要的是灵石，十万灵石！”
content_en:
Taixuanzong, inner sect.
Ye Changtian reported to the Inner Sect Affairs Office, received the clothes and identity tokens of the Inner Sect disciples, and then came to the residence assigned to him by the Inner Sect.
This is an independent courtyard covering an area of ​​two to three hundred square meters.
Ye Changtian checked the environment of the courtyard and was obviously quite satisfied with the conditions here.
Disciples of the inner sect of Taixuan Sect can not only live in the main peak with the richest aura to practice.
And there is such an independent courtyard as a training cave.
Compared with the handyman disciples, this kind of treatment is as good as heaven or earth.
"Inner disciples can receive a thousand spiritual stones every month, and new inner disciples can also choose a magic spell for free. Why don't you go and get the benefits first?"
Ye Changtian rubbed his chin.
Although he has now broken through to the Foundation Establishment Realm, he has not practiced any magical powers.
With this level of cultivation alone, it would be no problem to torture a rookie in the Qi Refining Realm, but if he were to fight against a monk in the Foundation Establishment Realm, it would probably be too much.
Think of this.
Ye Changtian did not hesitate.
He first went to receive the cultivation resources of a thousand spirit stones, and then went to the Sutra Pavilion to select a magical power.
In the big world of Xuanhuang.
Magic and magical powers correspond to realms, and are divided into foundation-building magic, golden elixir magic, Nascent Soul magic and so on.
The spells in each realm are divided into low-grade, medium-grade, high-grade, and top-grade.
The higher the grade, the more powerful it will naturally be.
New inner disciples of Taixuan Sect can choose any foundation-building technique for free in the Sutra Pavilion.
Ye Changtian finally chose a top-quality foundation-building technique.
Cang Yan Sword Technique!
The reason why Ye Changtian chose Cangyan Sword Jue was mainly because he saw the introduction of Cangyan Sword Jue.
This Cang Yan Sword Technique is a simplified version of a golden elixir technique!
He may be able to restore the original appearance of this golden elixir technique with the help of the power of the yin and yang world of creation!
The fact was just as Ye Changtian expected.
When he put the Cangyan Sword Jue, which was rubbed by the elders of the Tibetan Scripture Pavilion, into the world of yin and yang creation, the Cangyan Sword Jue underwent earth-shaking changes under the influence of the power of Yin and Yang.
Get to the end.
A brand new technique appeared directly in the world of Yin and Yang creation.
Ye Changtian quickly checked the information about this technique.
Burning Xu Sword Technique!
The ultimate golden elixir technique!
Use your own cultivation to condense a Void Burning Sword Qi to destroy everything. If you practice to the extreme, you can burn a kilometer of space into nothingness with one sword!
"Hiss——"
Ye Changtian couldn't help but take a breath of cold air.
It is indeed the best golden elixir technique.
What a domineering power!
But——
Although the power of the golden elixir spell is a hundred times more powerful than the foundation-building spell, it is also many times more difficult to practice.
With his talent, it is not easy to practice any foundation-building technique.
It is definitely not an easy task to practice the Burning Xu Sword Technique.
Shaked his head.
Ye Changtian focused his thoughts on the Burning Xu Sword Jue and carefully observed the contents of the Burning Xu Sword Jue.
But in the next second.
Ye Changtian felt as if he was in a mysterious space, and then continued to practice the Qi Burning Xu Sword Technique.
Very quickly.
Ye Changtian became more and more proficient in the use of the Burning Xu Sword Technique.
Under such tireless training.
I don’t know how long it took.
A three-meter-long Burning Xu Sword Qi instantly cut a void crack in the space in front of Ye Changtian.
at the same time.
Ye Changtian also woke up from that mysterious state.
What shocked Ye Changtian the most was.
This Burning Xu Sword Technique has actually been deeply imprinted in his mind, as if he has actually practiced it thousands of times!
Ye Changtian looked incredulous.
The moment he used his mind to examine the Burning Xu Sword Art, he inexplicably entered a state of practicing the Burning Xu Sword Art.
When he wakes up, he will really master the Burning Xu Sword Technique!
This...what exactly is going on?
He remembered that when he restored the Cang Yan Sword Art to the Burning Xu Sword Art, the power of Yin and Yang in the world of Yin and Yang creation was aboutTwo thirds were consumed.
Now the remaining third is gone.
"Could it be that if I use my mind to check the spells in the yin-yang world of creation, I can also directly consume the power of yin and yang to practice the spells and master the spells instantly?"
Ye Changtian was suddenly excited.
It is worthy of being the world of Yin and Yang that possesses the most powerful creations of heaven and earth.
So awesome!
In this way, he no longer has to worry about the difficulty of practicing magic!
"This world of yin and yang defies heaven. The only flaw is that it is a gold-swallowing beast. The ten thousand spiritual stones obtained from Huo Feng'er have been spent again."
Ye Changtian smiled bitterly.
"Working hard to make money is the way to go."
Ye Changtian muttered to himself, and just as he was about to leave the Sutra Pavilion, he suddenly heard an unbelievable exclamation in his ears.
"Ye Changtian, you...why are you here?"
Ye Changtian raised his eyes, and a familiar figure appeared in his sight.
Former fiancée Liu Yanran.
I didn't expect to meet him here.
"Liu Yanran, what a coincidence."
The corner of Ye Changtian's mouth suddenly curved: "I have just been promoted to an inner disciple. I come to the Sutra Pavilion to receive a spell. Is there any problem?"
"Promoted to inner disciple? Is it just you?"
Liu Yanran seemed to have heard the funniest joke in the world, with a sneer on her face.
She knows better than anyone what kind of person Ye Changtian is.
Trash with false spiritual roots.
After three years of training at Zaoyu Peak, I still haven't broken through to the first level of Qi refining.
If you want to enter the inner sect, unless you are a very talented genius, you generally have to reach the foundation building level to be qualified!
How could Ye Changtian, a loser, be qualified to enter the inner gate?
"Believe it or not."
Ye Changtian curled his lips, not wanting to waste time with Liu Yanran, so he turned around and left.
"Ye Changtian, come with me!"
Upon seeing this, Liu Yanran grabbed Ye Changtian's arm and pulled Ye Changtian to a corner where no one was.
Ye Changtian threw Liu Yanran away and said angrily: "Liu Yanran, what do you want to do?"
"Tell me, how are you going to give me the image stone?"
Liu Yanran didn't talk nonsense and said coldly: "As long as you give me the image stone, I will agree to whatever you ask for."
She had to get the photo stone back from Ye Changtian no matter what.
She didn't want to be controlled by Ye Changtian her whole life!
"Can you really ask for anything?"
Ye Changtian glanced at Liu Yanran, looked at Liu Yanran with a smile, and then made a ten sign.
"Ten times is too many, once at most!"
Liu Yanran thought Ye Changtian wanted to have sex with her, so she gritted her teeth and said.
Anyway, she had had many encounters with Ye Changtian, and the experience was not bad. As long as she could get the image stone back, it wouldn't be a big deal to do it again.
"..."
Ye Changtian was numb.
What the hell is this woman's brain?
Does he look like that horny guy?
What I want is the spiritual stone!
Do you want your eight times out of ten to be useful?
"What happens once every ten times, you think it's quite beautiful."
Ye Changtian said with black lines all over his head: "What I want is spiritual stones, one hundred thousand spiritual stones!"
